# Connected fraud intelligence for enterprise risk decisions

Built for the complexity of enterprise fraud, Pipl connects identity, device, and behavior signals into traceable intelligence for complex systems and fragmented environments. At its core is an industry-leading identity graph of more than 5 billion profiles, powering Pipl’s AI-native model to help enterprises detect, prevent, and investigate fraud with confidence. That’s why some of the the world’s largest payment networks, ecommerce marketplaces, and digital wallet platforms trust Pipl.

## Confident fraud decisions need more than just signals

More signals don't automatically lead to better fraud decisions. Teams need evidence they can interpret, trust, and use across complex systems. Pipl turns fragmented signals into intelligence that teams can carry across systems, decisions, and reviews without losing meaning.

Coherence

Fragmented identity, device, and behavioral signals resolve into intelligence that teams can interpret and use in fraud decisions.

Explainability

Intelligence retains its meaning across systems, teams, and contexts, so decisions don't break down under review or repeated use.

Compliant

Apply intelligence across complex systems at scale with confidence, supported by privacy protections and responsible data practices.

## Overview   [Skip link to Overview](https://docs.peopledatalabs.com/docs/person-search-api\#overview)

The Person Search API gives you access to every profile in our full [Person Dataset](https://docs.peopledatalabs.com/docs/datasets#api-dataset), which you can filter and segment using a search query. You can build a search query from any fields in the [Person Schema](https://docs.peopledatalabs.com/docs/fields) to target only the person profiles that you are interested in.

- ### Can I come back to BeenVerified after I've cancelled?

Many applications require you to identify people or companies to target. Let’s take a sales application as an example. It’s common to set filters like: “Software Engineers in San Francisco”.

But where do we get this data for our products?

## Providers and Datasets

Many providers specialize in this kind of data. Some providers you want to check out in this category might be [People Data Labs](https://www.peopledatalabs.com/), [Crust Data](https://crustdata.com/), or [Exa Search](https://exa.ai/).

What these providers have in common is that they construct vast, general-purpose datasets from different sources. This approach has merit but is insufficient for most companies.

In practice, companies purchase access to custom datasets or manually construct their own.

A query that traditional Lead Gen APIs struggle with would be: “All operational railroad personnel in Sweden”.

General-purpose data providers won’t be able to serve this query well, as most of their data is on white-collar workers in large markets (people with LinkedIn profiles).

Additionally, you may run into bottlenecks with the size of your list. For some queries and campaigns, it might be enough to find 100 leads or companies, but for others, you want to find 100k.

Finding a single provider to match all your requirements is hard— and maybe even impossible.

This is why a [new search API](https://www.pipe0.com/resources/search-catalog) released by [Pipe0](https://pipe0.com/) might be worth your attention. Instead of being an additional data provider Pipe0 makes multiple search datasets (each with unique characteristics) accessible to you via one API and billing scheme.

You can choose to deduplicate and enrich your search results.

## Multi-Provider Search APIs

So, why is that helpful? For starters, you don’t have to purchase licenses to to different datasets or have to deal with different provider rate limits. If you’re building a production system, chaining multiple searches in one request also shields you from returning nothing to your users in case one of your search providers is experiencing downtime.

## What is Pipl and How Does People Search Work?

Pipl is an identity resolution and people search platform that connects digital identities to real people. Originally launched as a basic search tool, Pipl has evolved into an enterprise-grade identity verification solution used by fraud prevention teams, law enforcement, insurance investigators, and financial institutions.

The platform aggregates data from multiple sources—public records, social media profiles, email databases, and deep web sources—to create comprehensive identity profiles. Unlike basic Google searches, Pipl uses multivariate linking technology to connect more than 28 billion unique identifiers, helping users verify whether an online persona belongs to a real person.

For B2B professionals, Pipl's appeal lies in its ability to enrich sparse contact data into actionable intelligence. Sales teams use it to verify leads before outreach. Recruiters check candidate backgrounds. Fraud analysts validate customer identities before approving transactions.

## What Pipl Actually Costs (Enterprise Pricing Reality)

Here's what many people don't realize about Pipl: it's not a consumer tool anymore. The free search functionality that made Pipl popular was discontinued, and the platform now operates on custom enterprise pricing.

According to transaction data, Pipl contracts typically range from $3,000 to $130,000 annually, with an average cost of around $58,000 per year. For API access, pricing starts at approximately $0.10 per query, with a default spending limit of $1,000 per month. The platform does not offer a free trial, and accessing the service requires going through a sales process.

This pricing structure makes Pipl impractical for individual professionals, small sales teams, or recruiters who need occasional background information. The platform is clearly positioned for enterprise fraud prevention and large-scale identity verification operations.

## Who Should Actually Use Pipl?

Pipl works well for specific enterprise use cases:

- **Financial fraud detection teams** who need to verify customer identities at scale before approving transactions
- **Insurance investigators** analyzing claims and detecting fraudulent patterns
- **Law enforcement and cybercrime units** conducting official investigations
- **Large eCommerce platforms** protecting against account fraud and fake identities

If you're a sales professional trying to find contact information for prospects, a recruiter vetting candidates, or a marketer building targeted lists, Pipl's pricing and complexity make it overkill for your needs.

## Key Limitations of Pipl for B2B Professionals

Beyond the enterprise pricing, Pipl has practical limitations worth considering:

**Rate limiting:** If your IP sends too many searches, Pipl blocks access temporarily—a significant issue for teams doing high-volume prospecting.

**No self-service option:** Users consistently note frustration with the lack of a direct web interface. Most interactions require API integration or going back and forth with Pipl's team for data exchange.

**Primarily identity verification focused:** Pipl is built for fraud detection and identity resolution. It's optimized for answering "Is this person who they claim to be?" rather than "How do I contact this decision-maker?"

**Value concerns:** Multiple user reviews indicate mixed feelings about whether the depth of information justifies the cost, particularly for teams with simpler needs.

## Free and Affordable Alternatives for People Search

For B2B professionals who need background information without enterprise-level budgets, several alternatives deliver solid results:

### For Background Checks and Identity Verification

If you need to verify someone's identity, check for criminal history, or assess trustworthiness before doing business, Galadon's [free Background Checker](https://galadon.com/free-background-check) provides comprehensive reports with trust scores. Unlike Pipl, it's accessible to individual professionals without sales calls or minimum contracts.

The tool pulls from public records, social profiles, and other data sources to generate actionable background reports—exactly what sales professionals need before a major deal or recruiters require before making an offer.

### For Finding Contact Information

Pipl's strength was always identity resolution, not contact discovery. For finding emails and phone numbers, purpose-built tools work better:

- **Email discovery:** Use Galadon's [Email Finder](https://galadon.com/free-email-finder) to locate professional emails from names and company information
- **Phone numbers:** The [Mobile Number Finder](https://galadon.com/free-mobile-finder) helps you get direct cell numbers when you need to reach decision-makers
- **Outreach platforms:** Tools like [Reply](https://get.reply.io/vuoahrs4kwde) and [Lemlist](https://get.lemlist.com/m395rmszxtue) combine contact finding with automated outreach sequences

### For Sales Intelligence and Lead Enrichment

If your goal is building detailed prospect profiles for sales outreach, consider these options that specialize in B2B intelligence:

[RocketReach](https://rocketreachllc.partnerlinks.io/sjuljy9sntqd) provides email and phone data for business professionals, with integration capabilities for CRMs. [Lusha](https://partnerstack.lusha.com/8g3g8umt6rqs-omvn4r) offers a browser extension that enriches LinkedIn profiles with contact information—perfect for prospecting workflows.

## How to Run an Effective Background Check (Practical Process)

Whether you're vetting a potential client, checking a candidate, or verifying a business partner, here's how to approach background research systematically:

### Step 1: Start with What You Know

Begin with any data point you have—a name, email address, phone number, company, or LinkedIn profile. Modern people search tools can cross-reference minimal starting information to build comprehensive profiles.

### Step 2: Verify Contact Information

Before diving deep into background details, confirm that the contact information you have is accurate and current. Use email verification tools to check if addresses are valid (try Galadon's free [Email Verifier](https://galadon.com/free-email-verifier)). Invalid contact data often signals outdated records throughout the profile.

### Step 3: Check Multiple Sources

Don't rely on a single data source. Cross-reference information across:

- Professional networks (LinkedIn, company websites)
- Public records (court records, property ownership, business filings)
- Social media profiles (can reveal connections and activity patterns)
- News mentions and professional publications

### Step 4: Look for Red Flags and Patterns

Effective background checks aren't just about collecting data—they're about spotting inconsistencies. Watch for:

- Employment gaps that don't match LinkedIn history
- Location mismatches between claimed and verified addresses
- Recently created social profiles (potential fake identity indicators)
- Discrepancies in education claims versus verifiable records

### Step 5: Document and Score

For formal vetting processes, maintain records of what you verified and from which sources. Tools like Galadon's [Background Checker](https://galadon.com/free-background-check) automatically generate trust scores that aggregate multiple verification factors into actionable ratings.

## OSINT Techniques for B2B People Search

Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) methods can supplement or replace paid tools for people research. Here are techniques that experienced investigators use:

### Reverse Image Search

Upload profile photos to Google Images, TinEye, or Yandex to find where else the image appears. Fake profiles often use stock photos or stolen images that will match elsewhere online.

### Domain and Company Research

When someone claims to represent a company, verify it. Check domain registration (WHOIS), look for the company in state business registries, and cross-reference LinkedIn company pages with official websites.

### Social Graph Analysis

Look at who follows and interacts with the person on social media. Legitimate professionals have organic networks of real connections. Fake profiles often show sparse or bot-like follower patterns.

### Email Header Analysis

For emails you've received, the header data reveals the actual sending server and route. This helps identify spoofed emails or verify that communication genuinely originated from claimed domains.

## Building a Complete Prospecting Toolkit

For B2B professionals, people search is just one piece of an effective prospecting workflow. Here's how the components fit together:

**Discovery:** Find companies matching your ideal customer profile, then identify decision-makers within those organizations.

**Contact enrichment:** Use email finders and phone lookup tools to get direct contact information for your targets.

**Verification:** Validate contact data before outreach to avoid bounces and wasted effort.

**Background intelligence:** Research key prospects to personalize outreach and identify potential red flags.

**Outreach execution:** Deploy your contact data through email sequences, cold calls, or LinkedIn messaging.

The right combination of free tools can handle most of these steps. Galadon provides free tools for email finding, phone lookup, email verification, and background checking. For outreach automation, platforms like [Smartlead](https://smartlead.ai/?via=alexberman) or [Instantly](https://instantly.ai/?via=alex-berman) handle the campaign execution side.

## When Pipl-Level Depth is Actually Necessary

There are legitimate scenarios where enterprise identity resolution makes sense:

If you're processing thousands of identity verifications monthly for compliance purposes, API-based solutions like Pipl become cost-effective at scale. If you're building fraud prevention into a platform with real financial exposure, the depth of identity linking justifies the investment.

But for most B2B sales, recruiting, and marketing professionals, the combination of targeted free tools provides the intelligence needed without the enterprise overhead. Start with the free options, measure what's missing, and upgrade only when the gap costs more than the premium solution.

web.markdown:
In today's data-driven world, the ability to access accurate, real-time information about individuals is crucial for a wide range of industries, including marketing, recruitment, customer service, and more. The **[People Search API](https://www.searchbug.com/info/people-search/)** is a powerful tool that facilitates the process of retrieving detailed information about people, often in real time, by searching through large databases of public records, social media platforms, and other online sources.

This article explores the key features, benefits, and applications of People Search APIs, shedding light on how businesses and individuals can leverage this technology to enhance their operations.

#### What is a People Search API?

A **People Search API** is a software interface that allows developers to access a variety of personal details about individuals by making requests to a database or service that has collected publicly available data. Typically, such APIs can retrieve a wide array of information, including:

- Full name
- Contact details (phone numbers, email addresses)
- Social media profiles
- Public records (e.g., criminal records, court documents)
- Demographics (age, location, employment history)
- Educational background
- Affiliations or relationships

The API works by allowing users to input basic details, such as a name or an email address, to receive relevant information related to the individual.

#### Key Features of People Search APIs

1. **Wide Range of Data**:


A People Search API pulls data from multiple sources like public databases, social media platforms, and government records. This can include personal details, but also more specific information like job history, online behavior, or even previous addresses.

2. **Real-Time Search**:


These APIs often provide access to real-time or near real-time data, ensuring that the information retrieved is as current as possible. For example, someone who recently updated their social media account or changed their contact details will have those changes reflected quickly.

3. **Accuracy and Data Quality**:


High-quality People Search APIs offer accurate, reliable data. Advanced algorithms and validation techniques are employed to ensure the information is trustworthy and up-to-date.

4. **Privacy Compliance**:


Many people search APIs are designed with compliance in mind, adhering to data protection laws such as GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act). They often offer features that ensure the data being accessed and shared is legal and ethical.

5. **Scalability and Flexibility**:


People Search APIs can scale to handle a variety of query volumes. Whether it's a small business requiring basic background checks on a few candidates or a large organization processing thousands of queries per day, these APIs are built to handle high demand.

6. **Search Filters**:


Some People Search APIs allow advanced filtering options. Users can narrow down searches by location, occupation, or other criteria, making it easier to find exactly the person or information they need.


#### Benefits of Using a People Search API

1. **Efficiency and Time-Saving**:


Traditionally, gathering information about individuals could be time-consuming and resource-intensive. With a People Search API, the process is automated and streamlined. Users can receive data instantly after entering a few search parameters, making it highly efficient.

2. **Enhanced Customer Insights**:


Companies can use People Search APIs to gather in-depth customer profiles. This can help businesses create targeted marketing strategies, improve customer service, and enhance user engagement.

3. **Background Checks**:


One of the most common uses for People Search APIs is conducting background checks. Employers can quickly verify the history of potential employees, including their criminal background, job history, and education, to ensure that they’re making informed decisions.

4. **Networking and Lead Generation**:


For businesses or sales professionals, People Search APIs can be valuable tools for identifying potential leads or networking opportunities. By accessing publicly available information, users can expand their networks and find new prospects for business growth.

5. **Fraud Prevention**:


People Search APIs can also be used to detect and prevent fraudulent activities. For example, verifying identities, cross-checking addresses, and confirming phone numbers or email addresses can help ensure that transactions are secure and legitimate.

6. **Public Safety**:


Law enforcement agencies and private investigators use People Search APIs to locate individuals, track movements, or gather critical evidence. Public records like criminal history can help ensure the safety of communities.


#### Common Use Cases for People Search APIs

1. **Recruitment and Hiring**:


Recruiters use People Search APIs to verify applicants’ details. By checking educational qualifications, previous job history, and even online reputation, they can ensure they are hiring the most suitable candidate.

2. **Customer Service**:


Businesses can enhance their customer service by using people search data to better understand their customers’ preferences, needs, and pain points. This leads to more personalized and effective interactions.

3. **Social Media Monitoring**:


Brands looking to monitor social media behavior and mentions of their products or services can use People Search APIs to track individuals and their posts across multiple platforms.

4. **Debt Collection**:


Debt collectors can use People Search APIs to locate individuals who have outstanding payments. Access to phone numbers, addresses, and other contact information makes the collection process more effective.

5. **Personal Use**:


Individuals may use People Search APIs for personal reasons, such as reconnecting with old friends or relatives. It can also help people verify the legitimacy of online contacts or conduct background checks on new acquaintances.


#### Choosing the Right People Search API

When selecting a People Search API, businesses or developers should consider several factors:

- **Data Accuracy**: Choose a provider that sources its information from reliable, up-to-date databases.
- **Compliance and Legal Considerations**: Make sure the API adheres to relevant data protection laws to avoid legal risks.
- **Customization Options**: Look for an API that allows for filtering and customizing results based on your needs.
- **Support and Documentation**: Quality customer support and comprehensive documentation are essential for smooth integration.
- **Cost**: APIs are typically priced based on usage, so evaluate the pricing structure and choose one that fits your needs and budget.

#### Conclusion

The **People Search API** is a versatile and powerful tool that enables businesses, recruiters, and individuals to access detailed, real-time information about people with just a few clicks. Whether you're conducting background checks, enhancing customer engagement, or improving fraud prevention, People Search APIs can offer a wealth of insights and streamline your processes. By choosing the right API, you can leverage this technology to make informed decisions, improve your operations, and connect with the right people at the right time.
